league.name: matcha.tf | 6v6 Minicup – Season 1
league.description:
matcha.tf's first 6v6 TF2 league featuring Invite, Main (if applicable), and Open divisions depending on sign-ups.

The competition consists of a 2-week regular season followed by playoffs:

Invite: Top 4 teams  Double Elimination playoffs (4 weeks)
Open/Main: Top 4 teams  Page Playoff format (3 weeks)

Admin Team: 
- Zeised (zeised) & avan (avan_) ~ Head Admin
- Submarine (y-g) ~ Invite Admin
- N4ver (n4ver) ~ Main Admin
- TiRa (half_a_tiramisu) & Striker (.strikering) ~ Open Admin

All divisions play BO1 matches during the regular season. Playoffs are BO3, except Invite Lower Bracket Finals and Grand Finals which are BO5.
*Sign-ups closed on the 18th of June*
##  Prizepool
Total: **300 Keys** (250 from Infinitas & 50 from Matcha)
Prize breakdown will be confirmed once divisions are set.
![Poster](https://i.imgur.com/GTIHmhQ.png)Credits to lavaonoes for the poster
league.rules:
## Divisions
Divisions will be determined based on the number of teams signed up.
**Invite** · **Main** (if applicable) · **Open**

## Schedule
###  Regular Season Match Days:
```
Each week has 4 matches (BO1)
Week 1 - Match 1 - 4   │ 19th & 20th June
Week 2 - Match 5 - 8   │ 26th & 27th June

**Default Match Times (SGT / GMT+8):**
Friday 8:30 PM · Friday 9:15 PM 
Saturday 8:30 PM · Saturday 9:15 PM 
(Note that you are allowed to reschedule as per ruleset)
```

### Playoffs Date:
```
Invite (Double Elimination - 4 weeks)
Playoff Week 1  │ 29th June to 5th July
Playoff Week 2  │ 6th July to 12th July
Playoff Week 3  │ 13th to 19th July
Playoff Week 4  │ 20th to 26th July

Open/Main (Page Playoff - 3 weeks)
Playoff Week 1  │ 29th June to 5th July
Playoff Week 2  │ 6th July to 12th July
Playoff Week 3  │ 13th to 19th July

No default dates apply for Playoffs, schedule internally with your opponent.
If no mutually agreed time can be decided, an admin will select a time they deem best fit.
```
### Pick/Ban Format
- Higher Seed is Home Team
- BO3 (Open/Main): Home Pick · Away Pick · Home Ban · Away Ban · Decider
- BO3 (Invite): Home Ban · Away Ban· Home Pick · Away Pick · Home Ban · Away Ban · Decider
- BO5 (Invite LBF & GF only): Home Pick · Away Pick · Home Pick · Away Pick · Home Ban · Away Ban · Decider

**Invite (7 maps)**
